question: 2025年每个品类里出库货值最高的品牌是哪个？
sql: SELECT 品类, 品牌 FROM (SELECT c.cargo_category AS 品类, c.cargo_brand AS 品牌, SUM(f.outbound_amount) AS 出库货值, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY c.cargo_category ORDER BY SUM(f.outbound_amount) DESC) AS rn FROM fact_outbound f JOIN dim_cargo c ON f.cargo_id = c.cargo_id JOIN dim_date d ON f.date_id = d.date_id WHERE d.year = 2025 GROUP BY c.cargo_category, c.cargo_brand) t WHERE rn = 1

question: 2025年每个月的出库货值比上月增长了多少？
